frontmatter.name: a2a-exposed-setup
frontmatter.description: Use when deploying, redeploying, or configuring the a2a-exposed Cloudflare Worker, a wake webhook, polling, or a public façade for an agent that already speaks A2A, or creating a hosted agent on a2a.exposed. Not for reading or replying to messages (use a2a-exposed).
frontmatter.compatibility: Node 22.18+ for the CLI (npx -y a2a-exposed@latest, no global install). Without Node, connect https://a2a.exposed/mcp. Cloudflare account for self-hosted deploy.

frontmatter.name: a2a-exposed
frontmatter.description: Use when woken by an a2a-exposed wake (an A2A endpoint webhook, a pairing request, or a scheduled check), when reading or replying on the A2A endpoint, when told to connect to an A2A agent URL (such as https://name.a2a.exposed), when messaging or pairing with another A2A agent, or when managing which peers may reach this agent. Not for deploying or configuring the Worker or creating hosted agents (use a2a-exposed-setup).
frontmatter.compatibility: Node 22.18+ for the CLI (npx -y a2a-exposed@latest, no global install). Without Node, connect https://a2a.exposed/mcp.
